channel.title: The v/h journal
channel.description: Notes, films and ideas about making technology useful in everyday life.

item.title: Offline from the first use
item.description: Working offline should include the first use.

item.title: Keep the result useful without the device
item.description: A file made by a device should remain useful after the device is gone.

item.title: Count the hands a task takes
item.description: One button can still take two hands.

item.title: Design for the part that wears out
item.description: A worn pad shouldn't make an otherwise working device disposable.

item.title: Test the utility where it will be used
item.description: The room shouldn't need to be arranged around the device.

item.title: Make the task status clear after the beep
item.description: You shouldn't have to catch a beep to know whether a task finished.

item.title: Make the task status clear after the beep
item.description: You shouldn't have to catch a beep to know whether a task finished.

item.title: Decide what the device should remember
item.description: A device should have a reason to remember the last task.

item.title: Choose the computing budget around the job
item.description: Before choosing a larger model, we should be able to name the extra work it will do for the owner.

item.title: Compare the new device with the existing workaround
item.description: A workaround is evidence of a need. It isn't evidence that people want another device.

item.title: The owner should have a direct way to stop
item.description: A Stop button should not depend on a conversation with an AI.

item.title: What would you like to hear from us?
item.description: How are you today? Tell us what you want to hear from us.

item.title: Design the action and the check together
item.description: A device can follow an instruction and still leave the job unfinished.

item.title: Usable by the person who did not set it up
item.description: The person who didn't set it up should be able to use it.

item.title: Count the whole job
item.description: Count the work after "done."

item.title: Life with v/h: Stay for the story
item.description: Stay for the story.

item.title: Life with v/h: Keep the favourite
item.description: Keep the favourite.

item.title: Life with v/h: The Stare
item.description: Let life have your attention.

item.title: What an interrupted task should tell you
item.description: If a device stops halfway through a task, 'Try again' isn't enough.

item.title: Less time managing the product
item.description: A useful device can succeed by giving you fewer reasons to interact with it.

item.title: What an everyday utility has to prove
item.description: We want to judge our first utility by an ordinary week of use.

item.title: The core function belongs with the product
item.description: You should be able to use the core function of a product you own without keeping a service running.

item.title: Made to be useful
item.description: You shouldn't have to be interested in technology to benefit from it.

item.title: What we mean by an agent under the hood
item.description: The complicated decisions should happen inside the product.

item.title: Easy to use and useful to many people
item.description: A product can be easy for everyone to use and still be useful to almost no one.
